text:
alyssa: quick q — candidate offer for UK Sr PM (London) has a delayed start (6/1 -> 7/1). Hiring mgr is ok but benefits team says new hire will hit the benefits waitlist and pension auto-enroll window may shift. comp band in offer uses 'Senior' band but hiring manager argues this candidate maps to "Lead" for scope. do we need an approval route for a band uplift + late enrollment accommodation?
mario: short answer: yes for the band uplift. need comp committee sign-off for uplift beyond band top. for benefits waitlist we can backdate pension enrollment only with payroll/finance approval.
sara: tagging process: please create an exception ticket in the approval queue and assign to @mario for comp review, @devon for payroll consequences, and @priya for compliance/legal sign-off. include candidate start/date change and justification. :point_down:

Example payload to paste in ticket:
```
Role: Senior PM -> requested Lead PM band uplift
Start: 2026-07-01 (moved from 2026-06-01)
Reason: scope + competing offer retention
Requested by: Emma (hiring manager)
Requested allowances: backdate pension enrollment to original start OR one-time company contribution to bridge gap
```

kevin: i can add the candidate note + counteroffer history in the ticket. FYI hiring mgr Emma says market comp for similar role is ~10% above our Senior top. candidate needs certainty by EOD tomorrow.
devon: finance: backdating pension is messy for UK payroll cycles but we can do a one-time company contribution prorated. will need headcount code and GL. also need evidence that candidate would've been enrolled on original start date.
priya: legal/compliance: need to confirm there are no regulatory issues w/ retro contributions. if we do uplift, we must record approval rationale (benchmarks, hiring risk). I can review the writeup once ticket created.
emma: adding voice: we will lose candidate if we don't at least confirm band uplift review and a benefits mitigation plan. happy to provide market comps.
alyssa: action items: 1) kevin to open ticket + attach market comps (today) 2) mario to route to comp committee (urgent) 3) devon to confirm payroll workaround (by EOD) 4) priya to pre-check compliance wording. i'll loop hiring mgr.
kevin: ticket opened #PO-8421 and linked candidate file. added comps and offer history. assigning @mario @devon @priya.
offer-bot: PO-8421 created by kevin at 3161122357
mario: reviewed initial packet — this looks like a band uplift case. i'll put it on tomorrow's comp committee agenda. if committee approves uplift >10% we need exec sponsor sign-off.
devon: noted. i'll prepare the payroll impact calc and options (backdate vs one-time contribution) and upload by 1600.
priya: will review compliance risks today and flag anything that blocks retro contribution; otherwise i'll prepare suggested approval language.
alyssa: thanks all — ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
